mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from GEO for Local Businesses optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe to see results from GEO for Local Businesses optimization can vary. Initial improvements, such as enhanced Google Business Profile visibility, might be noticed within a few weeks to a couple of months. However, significant ranking improvements and increased local traffic typically take three to six months, as search engines evaluate and index your optimized content and local signals. Consistency in strategy and ongoing efforts are key to sustaining and building upon these results over the long term.
